preconditions: 0x005508A0 requires a2 to point to a null-terminated file name and a caller-owned output struct of at least 0x20 bytes; the file type must be valid for the off_5DC050 extension table or the call returns -1 immediately.
0x00550AD0 requires a readable file handle in a2; the this pointer must point to a mesh_data output struct into which the header is parsed.
0x00543FA0 requires a valid this on a resource-manager object; any non-null arrays at +0x150 and +0x1B8/+0x1C0/+0x1C8/+0x1D0 are freed and replaced on entry.
0x0053CE10 passes a1 (a pointer to a pointer) and a2 through to the MAS loader 0x0053CBC0 unchanged.
postconditions: 0x005508A0 returns 0 when the mesh loads successfully and -1 on every failure path after reporting a specific error string through the error reporter 0x0053C590.

0x00550AD0 returns 0 on success; on a short read it frees the temporary buffers dword_8B8F30/dword_8B8F34 and returns -1. On success it leaves this+0x0 (flags), this+0x4 (scale, inverted to 1.0/scale), this+0x8 (dimension), the name at this+0x1C and the block arrays at this+0x10/+0x18 populated.
0x00543FA0 returns 0 on success and -1 when a scene/audio list walk aborts; the four bucket arrays are re-allocated consistently with their mirrored counts.
0x0053CE10 returns the loader result unchanged; on a zero (success) result with a1 non-null it sets bit 3 (0x8) in the flags dword at loaded_object+0x114.
side_effects: Heap allocations and frees through the internal new/malloc and free wrappers (cut edges to 0x00587C03 / 0x00587BCF) for the draw-element array, the four bucket arrays (0x00543FA0) and the mesh_data descriptor arrays (0x00550AD0).
Global writes: dword_8B8F30 and dword_8B8F34 are allocated and freed within one 0x00550AD0 call; dword_8B8F3C is reset to 0 before header parsing.
InterlockedDecrement on the global addend 0x008B8EEC on every second node of the audio list walk, followed by an audio volume load computation (0x00543FA0).
On successful load 0x0053CE10 ORs bit 3 into loaded_object+0x114, marking error-handling state on the loaded MAS object.
0x005508A0 zeroes its output struct (0x0..0x18 dwords and byte at +0x1C) on entry.
